confirmed_findings.title: Whole contaminated packaging mass lacks its material/water change leg
confirmed_findings.description: The pool equality uses only whole component receipts P/I/N_ext/ER versus closing stock and S/EO/W, while requiring actual material/water changes separately. W for the actual LDPE film is expressly the whole contaminated article with composition subaccounts (627), not dry-polymer-only mass. A10kg actual conditional film article received as P and later discarded with0.1kg independently observed retained cleanup water/Pb contamination has W10.1, zero other legs. The explicit pool equality gives10=10.1; the conserving gross material gate gives10+.1=10.1. Recording the change independently and same-side duplicate correction do not supply the missing input to this component pool. Unlike39333 there is no explicit residual-content exclusion from the pool steel/PE mass.
